observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command to create or reconcile a dedicated OAuth application for Stripe marketplace, with a client ID, public client type, no secret, and provisioning config, while rejecting the provisioning orchestrator's client ID. P1.F7.H1: P1.F7.H1
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a command to establish the OAuth app that Stripe marketplace uses, separating it from the provisioning orchestrator's app. This supports Stripe marketplace integrations and token minting. P1.F7.H1

observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command to rotate OAuth access and refresh tokens for Stripe marketplace integrations, minting new tokens and revoking old ones, while handling partial Stripe secret store failures and orphaned tokens. P1.F8.H1: P1.F8.H1
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a command to rotate OAuth tokens for Stripe marketplace, replacing old credentials with new ones and cleaning up superseded tokens. P1.F8.H1

observations.behavior: Adds tests for the Stripe marketplace OAuth app creation command, including checks for correct client type, provisioning settings, rejection of the orchestrator client ID, and dry-run behavior. P1.F9.H1: P1.F9.H1
observations.posthog_connection: Provides tests to verify the Stripe marketplace OAuth app creation and reconciliation behavior. P1.F9.H1

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and model-layer changes. No implementation of the rotation command, no database migration, no Stripe API calls, no shared secret-store configuration. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds comprehensive tests for the Stripe marketplace OAuth token rotation command, including dry-run, failure handling, and mid-rotation refresh scenarios.
